description: Daily crowd-level forecast (cnctr_rate, higher = busier) for Korean tourist spots over the next ~30 days, for comparing days or spots. Names match in Korean; search_places with locale 'ko' returns the Korean name. Gwangju and Jeollanam-do are not covered since July 2026 (the source dropped them).

date.description: YYYY-MM-DD. Omit for all forecast days.

poi_name.description: Spot name in Korean (partial match), e.g. '경복궁'.

name: get_crowd_forecast
title: 30-day crowd forecast
